sentences.sentence: While looking out the window, Fogg had decided to hire John.
After Fogg had hired John, they traveled around the world together.
Before Fogg and John got to Hong Kong, the ship's engines had broken.
John had been shining shoes when Fogg hired him.
Fogg looked for a boat after he had arrived in Hong Kong.
John had never been to Egypt before.
If Fix had gotten a warrant, he would have arrested Fogg.
By the time John left Suez, he had already talked to Fix.
